name: Jeff Gitelman
notes: The lane's guitarist-producer, and the entry describes the voicings precisely enough to author them: "**guitar-voiced harmony** — rootless upper-structure shapes on the top four strings (3rd-7th-9th-13th), quartal voicings, chromatic voice-leading between them, and real 4-to-8-bar motion; also blues harmony (I7–IV7–V7) where the guitar leads". Rootless upper structures are why `extensions.triad` is at the floor and the ninth is high while the voicing register is narrow and guitar-shaped rather than piano-wide; chromatic voice-leading is `topVoiceStepwise` with a high `adjacentSecondProb`; the blues family is authored with its sevenths in `extensions`. ⛔ **`bass808` is null**: "played bass or a warm short sub following the guitar's chord roots; slides are rare", so `followRootsProb` is high and `glideProb` is at the floor. Drums are explicitly "not his primary role" — a soft programmed kit with the backbeat on 2&4, live cymbal overdubs and finger-snaps — so the kit here is deliberately plain and the model's weight sits in chords and countermelody. "His presence is the reason a modern R&B record has a guitar solo at all" is the arrangement's real instrumental section and the counter's high `densityRatio` on `answer_lick`. ⚠ `confidence` is **low**, mirroring the entry's medium-low: "his guitarist-producer role and placement context are sourced; parametric detail is inference from the records". ⚠ Every drum number, the swing amount and the bassline figures are **INFERRED**. ⚠ `session.bpm.mode` is **INFERRED**: the number is not stated in the entry, and it is an authored centre of gravity inside the band the entry does state. ⚠ **`session.keys` is INFERRED.** The entry's Keys line describes the harmonic grammar but names no key centre, so these values and their weights are an authored choice — no key in this set is stated in the research. ⚠ **`drums.kick.lockTo808` removed (2026-08-17, 808 gate).** This kit has no 808 — `bass808` is `null` here or in the parent it inherits — and `lockTo808` is the one parameter that says *how much of the kick the 808 follows*, so in this file it described a pairing that does not exist: `generators::drums::bass808` returns on `block.is_none()` before the value is ever read, which makes it provably dead here. Where it was NOT dead was in the artists and producers who extend this kit and author an 808 of their own: they inherited the zero, `kicks.iter().filter(|_| rng.random_bool(0.0))` kept nothing, and their sub lane was silent at every seed — `bass808::every_shipped_model_with_an_808_produces_a_playable_line` reported "no 808 at all" for 35 of them. Removing it restores the engine's documented default of 1.0 for exactly those children and changes nothing here. ⚠ No researched claim moved: this kit's own statement about the 808 is the `bass808: null` beside it, and that is untouched.
